$comment: Which platform this app runs on (Pkg 5.7). "packages": true — the app takes the platform as packages: the version is
"commit" (the release `dotnet new` wrote, and every bump after), and PlatformOwnershipSuite holds the register files to
the ones that package ships. "brand" maps the platform's tokens to this app's, so a register file compares equal
whether its brand was written into it or not.
